mainEntity.name: How much does a Hyundai i20 N 1.6 T-GDi engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full rebuilt Hyundai i20 N 1.6 T-GDi engine typically costs between £3,200 and £4,800 for supply only. Reconditioned units start around £2,500, while used engines can be found from £1,500. Prices vary based on whether you choose supply-only or a full supply and fit service.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of turbo or engine failure in a Hyundai i20 N?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early warning signs include excessive oil consumption, blue smoke from the exhaust under heavy acceleration, and a noticeable loss of boost pressure or turbo lag. You might also hear unusual whining or rattling noises from the turbocharger area.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Hyundai i20 N?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, given the current performance car market. A well-maintained Hyundai i20 N holds a value of £18,000 to £25,000+. Investing £3,200-£4,800 in a rebuilt engine with a 12-month warranty is financially viable and protects the appreciating asset value of this sought-after hot hatch.

mainEntity.name: What is the G4FJ engine code in the Hyundai i20 N?

acceptedAnswer.text: The G4FJ is the specific 1.6-litre four-cylinder turbocharged Gamma engine code fitted to the Hyundai i20 N (producing 204hp, or 280hp with N Grin Boost). It features a larger turbocharger, upgraded intercooler, and performance-tuned internals compared to standard Gamma units.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Hyundai i20 N 1.6 T-GDi engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional supply and fit service for a Hyundai i20 N 1.6 T-GDi typically takes 2 to 3 working days. This includes the removal of the old unit, thorough cleaning of the engine bay, installation of the replacement engine, and comprehensive ECU coding.

problems.h4: Turbocharger Wear & Oil Consumption - Why the Hyundai i20 N 1.6 T-GDi G4FJ Wears Prematurely
problems.rootCause: Aggressive driving, frequent track use, and high boost pressures accelerate turbocharger bearing wear. Combined with direct injection, this can lead to oil consumption and carbon buildup on intake valves if maintenance intervals are extended.

Given the premium retained value of the i20 N, a rebuilt or reconditioned engine is a financially sound investment that protects the vehicle's strong asset value.
problems.recommendation: If your i20 N is exhibiting minor oil consumption or boost irregularities, targeted maintenance and strict adherence to short service intervals is highly cost-effective.
